name: 27368-shortprefill-16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU, --gres=gpu:1), SM90, 132 SMs.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One in-process vLLM engine, one process, no NCCL.
architecture: MoE decoder (DeepseekV2ForCausalLM), 15.7B total / ~2.4B activated, bf16, ~31 GB of weights: 27 layers, 64 routed + 2 shared experts, top-6 routing, hidden 2048, multi-head latent attention (16 query heads, kv_lora_rank 512, head_size 576, v_head_dim 128). Read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 1024 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion so 768 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: prompt exactly 512 tokens and output exactly 16 (min = max on both), greedy at temperature 0.0, so every request is the same shape. `request_format: plain` is load-bearing -- the backend's default applies the tokenizer's chat template and the engine then sees 518 or 519 tokens for a declared 512, so the -Chat checkpoint is served here with no chat template. ignore_eos is forced whenever max_tokens is set, so all 16 output tokens are generated; prefix caching is off, so each request prefills its whole prompt.
purpose: A 16-billion-parameter chat assistant giving brief replies to half-page prompts for eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line, at commit ca76486a16fbf9659a80e8b34b919e0065108f25.
# `git describe` calls that commit `v0.11.1rc2-35-gca76486a16fb` -- 35 commits past the tag, so
# do not substitute a released 0.11.1rc2 here; that is a different engine.
# CAUTION, flat reader: every key must be top-level and every value must fit on one line.
# Values the engine would otherwise resolve from its usage context are written down here so
# they cannot drift. Nothing below is tuned.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# Required, not decorative: `deepseek_v2` is not a model_type the pinned transformers knows,
# so AutoConfig cannot load this repo's config without it.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# The only KV page size the attention backend pinned in tuned.yaml accepts; the engine forces
# it to 64 by itself. Written down so it cannot be reached by a different route.
block-size: 64

enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
